Title: Dream World and Mokole Blood question

Messages.Author: dvorax
Messages.Body:
1) After playing Dream World at superior, I take control of a vampire
via Temptation. Does he get the +1 bleed, too?

Dream World:
[PRE] +1 stealth action. Each of your minions get +1 bleed for the
remainder of the turn or until a bleed action is blocked. Only one
Dream World can be played at superior each turn.

2) Can I search my ash heap AND my library after equiping with Mokole
Blood, or do I have to choose where I take the cards from (if so, do I
have to declare it as I play the card)?

Mokole Blood:
Search your library or ash heap for up to four cards requiring ...
Shuffle afterwards ...

Messages.Body:

No.
See also Annabelle Triabell.

> 2) Can I search my ash heap AND my library after equiping with Mokole
> Blood, or do I have to choose where I take the cards from (if so, do I
> have to declare it as I play the card)?
>
> Mokole Blood:
> Search your library or ash heap for up to four cards requiring ...
> Shuffle afterwards ...

You may pull from both library and ash heap, yes.
